where: The final battles: Warden Còr at the Umbral Spire summit, and Star-tender Fenn's post-game duel
mood: The last stand on the black mountain — grand, tragic and driving: a sorrowful antagonist who wants a gentle endless night, and the light that will not go out.
core_styles: B minor with a hopeful lift to D major
timpani rolls and heavy sampled battle drums
final boss battle theme, epic, tragic and sorrowful, never cartoonish

sections.name: Eclipse
sections.text: {the final confrontation begins: a massive pipe organ chord, a timpani roll, then a fast descending organ run that crashes into the driving boss theme}

sections.name: Boss Theme
sections.text: {the boss theme: a grand, sorrowful minor melody on the soaring lead over a relentless sixteenth-note bass ostinato and organ chords, heavy and driving}

sections.name: Boss Theme Reprise
sections.text: {the melody again, now doubled by powerful brass, the organ fuller, timpani hits on the accents, the stakes rising}

sections.name: The Gentle Dark
sections.text: {contrast: the drums drop to a slow heartbeat, a quiet, tender, almost lullaby-like organ and bell melody — the seductive sorrow of a night that never ends — then a timpani crescendo}

sections.name: The Light Holds
sections.text: {a hopeful heroic lift to D major: the lead and brass sing the melody in major over driving drums — the light that refuses to go out}

sections.name: Boss Theme Return
sections.text: {back to B minor, the grand boss theme at full power; the last bar is a timpani and drum fill leading straight back into the theme, no ending}
styles: seamless loop back to the start of the theme
